name: showTabs
label: Show tabs
description: Show or hide the 'Lists' and 'My Lists' tabs

name: tabItems
label: Tab items
description: Tabs to display in the list menu

name: selectedTabId
label: Selected tab ID
description: ID of the tab to be selected on initial load

name: menuItems
label: Menu items
description: Lists to display in the content tree of the menu

name: selectedItemPath
label: Selected item path
description: Path of the currently selected item in the list menu

name: selectedListMenuItem
label: Selected list menu item
description: Currently selected item in the menu.

name: expandedItems
label: Expanded items
description: Menu items to be expanded on initial display

name: loading
label: Is menu currently loading
description: When true, the list will display a loading spinner instead of the usual content

name: showListOpenedByLinkSection
label: Show lists opened by link section
description: Show the Opened by link section on the My lists tab, which temporarily stores lists created by accessing a URL.

name: emptyStateConfig
label: Empty state configuration
description: Title and body text to show in empty state message when no lists can be displayed

name: landmark
label: Include in landmark keyboard shortcut
description: Landmarks define main elements on the page. When you set this property to true, the component will be included in the landmark keyboard shortcut cycling behavior, allowing users to quickly jump focus back-and-forth between the main elements on the page.
